verdict.rationale: Unleash documents an official MCP server that lets LLM-powered coding assistants create and manage feature flags, so natural-language operation works, but only through an external AI client. The evidence shows no built-in natural-language interface in the Admin UI. The llms.txt agent instructions support AI-native use but are docs access, not command operation. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, coverage of operations beyond flag creation and management, hands-on or independent corroboration.
